title: Circuit Breaker State
description: Current state of a per-model circuit breaker for fault isolation

modelId.description: Identifier for the model/tier this breaker protects

consecutiveFailures.description: Number of consecutive failures since last success

failureThreshold.description: Number of failures before opening circuit

resetTimeMs.description: Time in ms before open circuit transitions to half-open

lastStateChange.description: Timestamp of the last state transition

lastFailure.description: Timestamp of the most recent failure

lastSuccess.description: Timestamp of the most recent success

failureRate.description: Rolling failure rate over last N requests
